claims: NASA's Artemis 2 mission launched successfully on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT (2235 UTC)
NASA's Artemis 2 mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida
Artemis 2 is a crewed test flight
Artemis 2 sends four astronauts around the Moon and back to Earth
Artemis 2 launch vehicle is Space Launch System (SLS) rocket
Crew of Artemis 2: Reid Wiseman (Commander), Victor Glover (Pilot), Christina Koch (Mission Specialist), and Jeremy Hansen (Mission Specialist)
Artemis 2 crew includes the first woman and first Canadian to travel to the moon
Artemis 2 crew is testing the Orion capsule's systems
